tests.description: Timed check on Planets & Their Properties

questions.question: Q: Which planet has the strongest greenhouse effect and why?
questions.correctAnswer: Venus — its thick CO2 atmosphere traps heat, raising surface temperature to about 460°C.

questions.question: Q: Why does Uranus appear blue-green?
questions.correctAnswer: Methane in its atmosphere absorbs red light and reflects blue-green light.

questions.question: Q: What causes Mercury's extreme temperature range?
questions.correctAnswer: Mercury has virtually no atmosphere to retain heat, so the sunlit side reaches ~430°C while the dark side drops to ~−180°C.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Planets & Their Properties

questions.question: Q: Name two distinguishing features of Mars.
questions.correctAnswer: Olympus Mons (the Solar System's largest volcano) and Valles Marineris (a vast canyon system).

questions.question: Q: Compare the compositions of Jupiter and Neptune.
questions.correctAnswer: Jupiter is mainly hydrogen and helium (a gas giant). Neptune contains more water, ammonia and methane ices (an ice giant).
